interface.description: Network interface to monitor (e.g., eth0, wlp3s0). Must be active and support packet capture.

bpf_filter.description: Berkeley Packet Filter (BPF) expression to filter traffic (e.g., 'host 192.168.1.1' or 'port 22'). Leave empty to monitor all traffic.

output_mode.description: Units and display mode: 'c' (cumulative bytes), 't' (total bytes since start), 'b' (bytes per second). Choose based on your monitoring goals.

host_limit.description: Maximum number of host connections to show in the top list. Increase for busy networks.

log_file.description: Path to append real-time logs (e.g., '/var/log/iftop.log'). Empty disables logging. Requires write permissions.

reverse_dns.description: Enable or disable reverse DNS lookups to display hostnames instead of raw IP addresses. May add latency.

dns_timeout.description: Timeout in milliseconds for DNS lookups. Increase if name resolution fails on slow networks.

port_map_file.description: Path to a file with custom service-to-port mappings (format: 'port service_name'). Required for non-standard services.

sort_by.description: Sort order for the host list: 0 (source), 1 (destination), 2 (total traffic). Choose based on your primary concern.

color.description: Enable colorized output (e.g., red for high traffic). Disable for terminal compatibility or log files.

log_level.description: Verbosity of diagnostic logging: 0 (quiet), 1 (normal), 2 (verbose), 3 (debug). Only effective if log_file is set.

ignore_hosts.description: List of IP addresses or substrings to exclude from display. Useful for excluding monitoring traffic or local services.

items.description: Host pattern (IP, hostname substring, or CIDR block like '192.168.1.0/24')
